meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为指定的 NanoClaw 群建立持久 wiki 知识库：创建 wiki/、sources/ 目录与 index.md、log.md，写入容器技能，并在群 CLAUDE.md 中加入一段 Wiki 说明，之后持续按你给的资料更新页面。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词时触发。动手前它会先读 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，并问你要把 wiki 建在哪个群。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: 它先读模式文档，再问建在哪个群

say.text: 把这个 PDF 收进 wiki
say.note: 文件逐个处理，读完一个再更新页面

say.text: 每周给 wiki 做一次体检
say.note: 用 schedule_task 工具安排定时 lint

howto.what_en: After install, Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: it creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, index.md and log.md, a container skill, and a Wiki section in the group CLAUDE.md, then keeps updating pages from sources you give it.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base" and similar keywords. Before building, it reads Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern and asks which group should host the wiki.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: It reads the pattern, then asks which group

say_en.text: Ingest this PDF into the wiki
say_en.note: Files are processed one at a time

say_en.text: Set up a weekly wiki health check
say_en.note: Scheduled via the schedule_task MCP tool
